general_summary: Filipe Fonseca da Costa was born in France in 1977. Graduated in Architecture from the Department of Architecture (DARQ) of the University of Coimbra in 2005. He collaborated with the architects Victor Mestre & Sofia Aleixo, in Lisbon, with MX-Si Architectural Studio, in Barcelona, and with Orange studio in Coimbra. He began his activity as an independent architect in 2014, where he has been developing projects in different areas.

DOSE is a collective rooted in the field of architecture that undertakes a proactive and multidisciplinary approach in the exploration of the urban contemporary realm. Working as a think-tank, its practice embraces endogenous and exogenous opportunities for the development of specific projects and non-prescriptive solutions. DOSE acknowledges different cultural sensitivities as important inputs for the construction of speculative and experimental strategies. Moving away from static and hermetic approaches, it promotes the dynamic use of tools and creative processes drawn from its multidisciplinary stance. The outcomes allow for subversion and entertainment as catalysts of stimulus and contamination. DOSE acts in the contemporary urban plays.

CNLL leaded by Nuno Lacerda Lopes, Architect and Lecturer at the faculty of Architecture of the University of Porto develops professional activity in areas as Architecture, Engineering, Design and Scenography . With more than twenty years of exhistence, CNLL reflects the values, methodologies, quality criteria and above all his idea of architecture based on man as the central figure of the built space, in an eternal appeal to the senses and a persistent and irreverent desire for experimentation whilst searching for new materials, forms and concepts of which his works are clear evidence.

general_summary: Nuno Montenegro's office boasts a team that can cater to the full range of technical project planning specialties, from urban planning to the design of public and private developments. The two cornerstones behind its concept are the set of partnerships it has entered into and its drive to foster experimental research. Montenegro's team can provide a design-oriented development concept, the hands-on benefit of a small dynamic company with a well-built network of knowledge connectors, and the technical lead and design expertise of a larger one. In its more than ten years of design practice, the company has earned a reputation for excellence in the master planning and the design of distinctive residential, educational, laboratory facilities, recreational, retail, and mixed-use projects. The approach to projects is collaborative both within the practice itself and in its relationship with clients and consultants, among others. These lines of collaboration are established and maintained right through to the completion of a project, allowing projects, from inception, to be considered holistically - from the aesthetic dimensions to questions regarding the environment, structural integrity, and issues related to cost, program, and value. The office is located near Lisbon, in Portugal, close to the salt marshes of the Tagus River estuary. Its structure occupies the totality of a small historical building in the town center. read in Português

The [N2X] team started it’s activity in the year 2004, comprising of Isabel Ourique and Pedro Furtado, both of which studied at Faculty of Architecture on the Technical University of Lisbon between 1997 and 2003. Constant collaborators between 2003 and 2006 in various offices in Lisbon, they now practice their activity in Ponta Delgada, in the Island of S. Miguel, Azores. Architecture in it’s practical current has become the priority and objective of this team. We look for valid ideas that have solid foundation on concepts. We experiment through drawings and detail, the reflection of the modulation of spaces built that transmit simplicity and pragmatism.
